title: Island Fortress Assault
intro_text: Intelligence reports that enemy forces have fortified a strategic island.
The fortress commands the approach to the main shipping lanes.
Your fleet has been reinforced with additional ships.
You now command sloops, brigantines, ships of the line, and frigates.
Objective: Destroy the enemy fleet and capture the island.
Use your ship diversity wisely - each vessel has unique strengths!
victory_text: VICTORY! The fortress falls and the island is secured!
Your coordinated naval assault has overwhelmed the defenders.
The shipping lanes are now under your protection.
Your reputation as a master naval tactician grows.
The fleet awaits your next orders, Admiral.
defeat_text: Defeat! The fortress guns proved too powerful.
Your ships have been driven back with heavy losses.
The enemy still controls the strategic position.
Regroup at the home port and plan a new approach.

title: The Narrow Strait
intro_text: The enemy has retreated to a narrow strait between islands.
Their position is defensible but limited in maneuvering space.
Use the channels and islands to your advantage and outmaneuver them.
victory_text: Excellent! The strait has been secured.
The enemy's defensive advantage was overcome by superior seamanship.
Your reputation as a naval commander grows.
defeat_text: The narrow waters proved too challenging.
Consider a different approach next time.
